Markets.title: MCX launches crude sunflower oil futures contract
Markets.summary: The Multi Commodity Exchange has launched crude sunflower oil futures contracts to help manage price volatility. This new financial instrument aims to provide importers, refiners, processors, and traders with an efficient risk-management tool.

Markets.title: Quote of the day by Robert Wilson: "Most of the people who are successful in the market are basically optimists, and most of these people are very uncomfortable when they are on the short side"
Markets.summary: Successful market investors are typically optimists who feel uncomfortable betting against the market through short selling. This psychological insight highlights the need for conviction, discipline, and balanced expectations when managing investment risks and market volatility.

Markets.title: Adani Energy Solution shares end 2% higher after acquiring Vizag Power Transmission
Markets.summary: Adani Energy Solutions shares rose two percent following its acquisition of Vizag Power Transmission from REC Power Development and Consultancy. The purchase supports power integration for upcoming green hydrogen and green ammonia projects in Vizag.

Markets.title: Rupee logs weekly decline, with RBI intervention curbing losses
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee declined against the dollar this week due to rising tensions from the Middle East conflict. However, central bank interventions and steady dollar sales by state banks helped limit further losses.

Markets.title: Sensex falls 71 points, Nifty closes below 24,400; broader markets underperform. What lies ahead?
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices closed lower on Friday, with the Sensex falling 71 points and the Nifty finishing below 24,400 amid underperforming broader markets. Analysts attribute the sideways movement to global yield uncertainty and oil prices, while technical indicators suggest key support near 24,200.

Markets.title: Quest Global said to pick banks for $1 billion India IPO
Markets.summary: Carlyle-backed engineering services firm Quest Global has hired five banks, including Morgan Stanley and Citigroup, to advise on a Mumbai initial public offering. The company is targeting up to $1 billion in the potential share sale and plans to file a draft prospectus by December.

Geo-Political.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
Geo-Political.summary: Unprecedented heavy rain in Japan killed eight people and left over 20,000 households without power. The storm also stranded 7,000 people at Tokyo's Narita airport.

Geo-Political.title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
Geo-Political.summary: A new US report states that dozens of countries helped China route goods through lower-tariff nations. This tactic allowed China to successfully bypass higher import levies imposed by the Trump administration.

Geo-Political.title: Engine parts smashed Ryanair window that man's head was sucked out of, report says
Geo-Political.summary: A preliminary US investigation report states that a broken engine fan blade on a Ryanair flight from Greece to Germany smashed a window. This caused a man's head to be sucked out of the opening.

Geo-Political.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
Geo-Political.summary: Sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln have endured deployments exceeding 250 days, leading to severe food shortages and broken plumbing. The harsh conditions have caused profound distress among the crew, with some reportedly contemplating jumping overboard.

Geo-Political.title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
Geo-Political.summary: Brazilian police recovered eight stolen artworks by French artist Henri Matisse at a home in greater São Paulo. One man was arrested in connection with the theft and recovery of the artwork.

Geo-Political.title: Presidential vote counting halted in Zambia over alleged attacks on polling staff
Geo-Political.summary: Zambia's electoral commission halted presidential vote counting following violent attacks on polling staff. The violence resulted in the theft of marked ballot papers.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This unexpected placement occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top ten artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay competitive and simplify their workflows in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten of the most advanced and widely used artificial intelligence tools of 2023. These technologies are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various industries.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: The article discusses the benefits of using AI content generators to create engaging and relevant material efficiently. It notes that with numerous tools available on the market, choosing the right one can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also provides examples of top programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation eased to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid volatile oil prices. This increase aligned with analyst expectations and could give the Federal Reserve more flexibility on interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, while elevated global oil prices continue to pose economic risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has maintained India's sovereign credit rating at BBB- for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong economic growth outlook. The agency also projected India's GDP growth at 6.4% while noting potential fiscal risks from youth protests over employment.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university education obsolete. He also emphasizes that improving employability is a greater challenge for India than simply creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation in July likely stayed unchanged at 4.4%. This occurred because a favorable base effect offset higher food prices while core inflation remained low.

India.title: "Miles To Go Before I Sleep": IIT Hyderabad Graduate's Journey From Amazon Offer To IIM Ahmedabad
India.summary: IIT Hyderabad graduate Vivekananda Pasam rejected an Amazon job offer and cleared the UPSC preliminary exams three times. He then scored the 99.92 percentile in the CAT exam after just 45 days of preparation to secure admission into IIM Ahmedabad.

India.title: Targeted Hits On Sukhbir Badal Expose Simmering Discontent In Punjab Ahead Of Polls
India.summary: Two recent attacks on Sukhbir Badal show that unresolved sacrilege cases have made him a target for radical anger and Khalistanis ahead of Punjab's polls. These violent incidents demonstrate how radical elements are exploiting the situation for political leverage.

India.title: Naga Villager Shot Dead, 3 Injured In Fresh Attack In Manipur Amid Peace Calls
India.summary: A Naga villager was shot dead and three others were injured in a fresh attack at Langka Naga village in Manipur. The incident occurred in a Kuki-dominant district located 45 kilometers from the state capital, Imphal.

India.title: Farooq Abdullah Raises Issue Of Threats To Kashmiri Pandits, Seeks Probe
India.summary: Farooq Abdullah has called for an investigation into recent threats directed specifically at Kashmiri Pandits. He questioned why members of this specific community are being targeted while people of various faiths live and work in the region.

India.title: Weather Today Live Updates: Delhi Gets Heavy Rain, Thunderstorms, Likely To Continue Over Weekend
India.summary: Delhi experienced heavy rain and thunderstorms that are expected to continue through the weekend. Additionally, authorities have issued a heavy rainfall alert for Uttarakhand until August 17.

India.title: Opinion: The Coast Pays, Delhi Collects: What The Centre's Mineral Bill Takes From States
India.summary: An opinion piece argues that recent mineral legislation shifts taxation power from resource-rich Indian states to the central government in Delhi. The author contends that this shift unfairly strips coastal and mineral-producing states of financial control over their own natural resources.

General.title: Video shows scale of devastation in Stourbridge
General.summary: Multiple fires devastated the West Midlands on Thursday. Firefighters were still working to control the blazes.

General.title: Farage's by-election victory won't stop questions about finances
General.summary: Nigel Farage triggered the Clacton by-election and the result was predictable - so what did he achieve?

General.title: Eurovision proposes new rules to reduce political voting
General.summary: Eurovision organisers plan to introduce new rules to combat persistent and deeply worrying political voting. The proposed changes aim to reduce the impact of geopolitical alliances on the song contest's final results.

General.title: The Office's Lucy Davis 'overwhelmed' by kindness after cancer diagnosis
General.summary: Actress Lucy Davis, known for her role in *The Office*, announced she has been diagnosed with incurable cancer. She expressed feeling overwhelmed and grateful for the kindness and support from well-wishers.

General.title: Mother jailed for killing baby by burning her with a hairdryer
General.summary: Courtney Gartshore was jailed for killing her three-month-old baby, Dahlia-Rose, by burning her with a hairdryer. Gartshore subjected the infant to significant and sustained heat on her head and body.

General.title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
General.summary: Police in Brazil arrested a man after recovering eight stolen artworks by French artist Henri Matisse. The pieces were found inside a home in the greater São Paulo area.
